temporal_scope: Four exact March/June/September/December2022snapshots,not seasonal means or annual extrema.
identity_scope: Ligurian is a regional Northern Current segment; preserve source relationship without inherited parent depth or additive volume.
method: Frozen unique paired finite depth contours and linear transverse strips between original consecutive native latitude columns only; native-supported first-to-last contiguous model depth span retained even where boundaries are censored.
minimum_span_interpretation: Minimum support is conditional on the original contiguous piecewise-linear signed-component model definition. It is not a physical named-current thickness bound. A single supported level gives zero minimum support, not zero thickness or flow absence.
range_interpretation: Sampling-bracket geometry scenarios, not confidence intervals, physical uncertainty, annual envelopes or guaranteed true-area bounds.
axis_anchor_interpretation: Discrete original model-selected axis proxies only; nine unresolved source cases retain null anchors and original candidate diagnoses. No between-section interpolation, stronger replacement core, current identity promotion or volume.
interpretation: Partial regional model-component depth shapes at each owner original primary cutoff (Balearic0.05m/s,others0.1m/s); areas from different cuts/dates/owners are not additive water volume. Missing support stays unknown.
source_credit: HYCOM Consortium,NRL,COAPS-FSU; original source methods,owners and branch scope retained.
run_note: Inclusive component-thickness lower support under original contiguous piecewise-linear model definition; single-level zero is an uninformative bound, not absence.
